agents-build-the-tools-they-work-with.title: Agents build the tools they work with
agents-build-the-tools-they-work-with.standfirst: Agents turn repeated work into tools, and some jobs become fully deterministic code. The tools give the model more reach than any traditional interface.

cover.alt: A dark build room at night: a row of identical open laptops receding along a bench, cabled together and all showing the same progress bar, with server racks glowing teal behind.

reference-code-makes-agent-builds-faster.title: Reference code makes agent builds faster
reference-code-makes-agent-builds-faster.standfirst: In my estimating work, a build with agents takes roughly a third of the time a human-only team needs and the code is better, because the working code the agents leave behind becomes the reference every later piece patterns off.

cover.alt: Overhead view of hands typing on a laptop at night, its editor split into two panes of code with the same shape, beside a notebook sketch of boxes and arrows, a mug and a teal desk lamp.

agents-report-is-not-evidence.title: An agent's report is not evidence
agents-report-is-not-evidence.standfirst: An agent will tell you, convincingly, that it finished. Build the checks around it so that claim never has to be believed.

cover.alt: Over the shoulder of a person at a desk at night with two monitors: a dense agent session on the left and a column of four green checks on the right, lit by a desk lamp.

every-generated-document-needs-a-rubric.title: Standardize document generation quality with a rubric
every-generated-document-needs-a-rubric.standfirst: AI can draft the documents a team writes over and over, and get better at it every week, once each document type has a rubric, an interview, and a person who dials the draft in and whose corrections teach it.

cover.alt: Over the shoulder of a printer at a night inspection table, holding a loupe over a fresh proof sheet beside the approved master proof, a stopped press and unprinted paper behind.

second-brain-needs-an-owner.title: A second brain needs an owner to build it
second-brain-needs-an-owner.titleAccent: needs an owner to build it
second-brain-needs-an-owner.standfirst: A second brain gets smarter every time it's used, as long as someone who knows the work decides what goes in.

cover.alt: Over the shoulder of a lawyer at a desk at night, one hand flat on an open case file and the other on a laptop keyboard, lit only by a gooseneck lamp.
